newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady. Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $20.00-$20.50 per cwt, Medium grain traded mostly at $19.00, second heads were steady at $14.00-$14.50 and brewers were in very tight supply with no sales reported. Rice by-products were uneven with bran prices $5.00 higher to $2.00 lower, mostly steady to $5.00 higher; millfeed was steady to $2.00 lower.
California rice prices steady to $0.50 cents lower with Medium grain selling mostly at $20.00-$20.50. Rice bran was $5.00-$13.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings: At the Port of Sacramento for the week ending October 19, 1996, no ships were loading.
Inspections of California rice for export: None for the week ending October 19, 1996. Yearly total since October 1, 1996 is -0- cwt versus -0- cwt a year ago.
